scope:
[t892] Solar-wing WIDTH fold (6 sections, 5 hinges) in NVIDIA Newton 1.7.0 (SolverFeatherstone), chained after the r11-lock solar run
(solar_t780_dt0.01_kl5000: all 21 accordion/root hinges latched by 747.5 s). Same modelling style and parameters as run_final_newton.py /
newton_xcheck_T45.py (motor mode): rigid bodies, zero gravity, no contact, fixed base, min-jerk PD motor with torque limit sized by
motor_par2 (margin 3, 3 deg error at limit, kd at zeta 0.7 on own hinge inertia), 3 deg overdrive, Coulomb friction F_NOM = 2 N m (eps 1e-3 rad/s),
captured penalty latch K = 5 kN m/rad (LOCK_KLAT) zeta 0.7 on min(outboard inertia, 64 x own hinge inertia) (LOCK_DAMP_CAP), motor off after
capture, stow-side stop, implicit damping through joint_armature (t476 fix).
Bodies: one wing's 6 full-length width sections (each wing_length x 14/6 m, array mass / 2 wings / 6). Base = section 1 (fixed: it is carried by
the latched leaf chain; the planar leaf chain and this width chain are run as separate planar models, as in the existing study).
Hinge axes = the wing length direction. Sections 0 | 1(base) | 2 3 4 5 ; folded angles (render convention) [-pi, -pi, +pi, -pi, +pi].
usage: python newton_wfold_t892.py TW DT TSETTLE [device]  -> wfold_newton_tw<TW>_dt<DT>.npz / .json
